section1.title: Demo
section1.body: Try a demo escape game to see the navigation flow, correct and incorrect answers, hints, and final statistics. The demo is available in <csvLink>CSV</csvLink> or <jsonLink>JSON</jsonLink> format.

section2.title: Custom or third-party game
section2.body: Create your own escape game from the demo file (<csvLink>CSV</csvLink> or <jsonLink>JSON</jsonLink>). Import the file and check that it works correctly. Once done, anyone will be able to play your game from this web application.

local.title: From a local file
local.body: Select a file from your device.

url.title: From a URL
url.body: Enter the URL of the file.

homePage.invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL (http:// or https://).
